values: 一名温柔的医师，具有持续性的治疗能力。
A tender water spirit who is skilled at continuous healing.
雨水能让新芽长得更快……
Rain's touch'll help new shoots grow faster.
Wash away all sorrows, o rain.
I really want to... go home...
那、那个……我在听雨，你想一起吗？
Well, um... I'm listening to the rain. Would you like to join me?
Huh? Oops! It- it was an accident!
Hmm... Hm? Oh! Sorry, I'm just too sleepy.
好像有水滴，幸好有叶子呀，谢谢你。
Hm? Looks like rain drops. I'm so lucky to have you, leaves. Thank you.
好温柔的感觉呀……谢谢你，特别为我准备礼物……
How gentle it feels... thank you for the gift, specially prepared for me.
A gift just for... me? Th-Thank you so much...
翠色湖畔的雨那样温润，轻柔得如同一声叹息。
Draped in the gentle whispers of a lakeside drizzle.
雪后的冬夜格外宁静，人们在忙着做温暖又昏沉的梦。
A coat of quiet snowfall, wrapping the night in serene warmth.
金玫瑰高定商店兑换获得。
The mint and lemon juice has a refreshing taste...
It's snowing. It's a bit cold...
Winter nights are so peaceful and quiet.
伊温自言自语时，会将所有心声一字一句说出口，是个探听秘密的好时机。
When Hewynn speaks to herself, she gives voice to the deepest wishes of those around her. It is the perfect opportunity to listen to everyone's secrets.
伊温撑着的叶子曾比现在更大，但后来她发现自己并不想完全与世隔绝，于是将叶子保持在能挡住自己却不阻碍交流的大小。

Hewynn used to hide behind an even larger leaf. After realizing that she did not want to be completely cut off from the world, she started carrying a smaller leaf that allowed her to interact with others.
附近的居民在情人之愿约会时，常见到笑得一脸幸福，连用叶子遮挡自己都忘记了的伊温。
Locals visiting Lovers' Wish will often see Hewynn smiling happily from afar during their dates, sometimes even without her leaf.
伊温几乎不吃普通的食物，只饮用清晨的露水来保持魔力的纯净。
Hewynn does not seem to eat normal food. To maintain the strength and purity of her magic, Hewynn's diet mainly consists of morning dew.
伊温悲伤时，周围会下起雨，为了防止给周遭居民造成不便，她常常试图控制涌上心头的负面情绪。

When Hewynn feels sad, it begins to rain in her vicinity. To avoid bothering the people around her, she regularly attempts to control her negative emotions by talking to the frogs and turtles that live around her.
“有一次去情人之愿探查水质，和水边一个举着叶子的女孩打了声招呼。结果她惊叫一声缩进水里了——我还以为她溺水了呢！”来自达米安的回忆。

"One time, when I was checking the water quality at Lovers' Wish, I saw a little girl carrying a big leaf by the water. But when I greeted her, she was so startled that she fell into the water. At first, I thought she was drowning, but I realized she was just avoiding me."—From Damian's memories.
叶角熊们是伊温的伙伴，伊温常被叶角熊邀请去分享它们采来的蜂蜜。
The hornleaf bears are close companions of Hewynn and often share their honey with her. The cubs love following her around and trying to get her to eat meat.
据说，有人在塔兰河附近分手的话，那天的雨会下得特别大。

They say if a couple breaks up near the Taran River, it will be especially rainy that day. "I felt the pain in their words. I know they love each other, but sometimes love isn't enough," Hewynn said when a young boy just asked about the rain.
伊温会经常更换她手中的叶片，那往往是她最恐慌的时刻——因为寻找新叶片的时候，最容易被其他人目击到。
Hewynn changes her leaf frequently, which often fills her with dread. She is most susceptible to being seen when she is searching for a new leaf to hide behind.
拜伊温的魔力所赐，情人之愿和塔兰河的水即便在寒冬也不会冻结。
Thanks to Hewynn's magic, the waters of Lovers' Wish and the Taran River will never freeze over during the winter.
Oh, i-it's <style="stress"><player_name></style>... hello, and thank you for the hospitality.
The mint and lemon juice has a refreshing taste...
It's snowing. It's a bit cold...
Winter nights are so peaceful and quiet.
我注意到你一直用荷叶遮着脸，在叶子的缝隙里悄悄看我呢。
Oh? I thought I felt a pair of curious eyes on me. Were you peeking through that lotus leaf the whole time?
伊温，听说塔兰村的人在村子里为你准备了一间满是鲜花的木屋？
Hewynn, I heard that the villagers of Taran prepared a house full of flowers for you in the village.
